args.text:
Batch: 8 runs, all 8 accepted. Flagged: 0. Cleared: 8 (r01–r08).
All three final checks passed on every run: rigid-body invariance, closure and plane sections. No run used the width-free ratio.
The large |z| values come from a very small batch MAD, so the real differences are tiny. REGR peaks are all within 0.04 %/h of 52.88 %/h. Every peak sits at 421 µm. Growth-zone lengths run from 674 to 695 µm. The flank-difference maximum is at 410 µm for r02 and r08 and at 421 µm for the rest. The strain-rate and curvature profiles all have the same shape.
r07 kept one remedy and its checks passed, which is the normal path. No run had a roll-back.
Note: some runs have identical checks and summaries (r01, r03 and r04; r05 and r06; r02 and r08). Please confirm these are separate roots or time windows and not duplicate entries.
Nothing flagged, so there is no shared pattern among flagged runs.
